changes: Markets: every number on Today and Patterns is calculated by SQL in your browser, from definitions kept, with every version, in the market data lakehouse
Markets: each ‹› button opens that number's calculation in its own window, live beside the page, with the query exactly as it runs for the type you chose
Markets: edit a number's SQL in its window and preview your version on your screen, next to the numbers in use
Markets: save your version to the lakehouse: it becomes your account's own (the owner's saves are the shared version), with every earlier version a click away and Use this version again to go back
Markets: Patterns runs on the same SQL engine, so its counts, the patterns that held up and every kind of move can be opened, edited and saved like Today's numbers
